content:
maria: 3,000,000 requests in a day!!! 😳🔥 :confetti_ball: Who's up for a sushi cart tonight to celebrate? (day shift + night shift)
devin: omg WHAT. huge. :tada: sushi cart sounds amazing. can we also do neon party hats?
sam: bringing hats + origami cranes. i'll fold 200 on my commute. :crane:
ops-bot: Deploys: all services stable. autoscaler healthy. no incidents in last 24h. :white_check_mark:
alex: minor ask — can night oncall get a small token? they held the fort past midnight. maybe "night patrol" sash? sash idea is goofy but cute.
jen: yes to sashes for night patrol. also mini drone confetti? lightweight + safe?
maria: love the sash + drones. sam pls no real drones near food. 😂
devin: i'll book sushi cart for 6:30pm outside building A. morning folks can grab early. is rooftop allowed after 8pm?
alex: rooftop reserved for party room at 7-9. confirmed w/ facilities.
jen: vote poll: sash or pins? react with :white_check_mark: for sash, :star2: for pin.
sam: :white_check_mark: (sash)
alex: :white_check_mark:
maria: :star2: (leaning pins but sash wins apparently)
devin: quick shoutout — special thanks to @jen for triaging the latency blip this morning. saved us from a nasty rollback.
jen: oh nooooo stop it you're gonna make me cry. :sob: team effort tho.
maria: photo idea — "team night patrol" banner with timestamp. any takers to design a quick mock?
sam: i can slap something together in Figma for the banner.
ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation tonight: alex -> devin -> jen. ping ops if anything pops.
alex: got it. will bring extra earplugs for the tiny drum.
devin: i'll bring portable speaker and playlist. suggestions? something upbeat but not too loud.
maria: 1) "We shipped it" instrumental 2) synthwave 3) bossa nova mix for the sushi line. vote 1/2/3.
jen: 2
sam: 3
alex: 1
maria: okay playlist = synthwave + bossa crossover. who wants to help set up?
devin: i'll handle setup. meet by loading dock at 6:15pm.
maria: night team — we saw you. this is for you too. sash/pins will be left with oncall kit if you're sleeping. love y'all. :heart:
